# Prairie Sky Drones

## About
Prairie Sky Drones provides FAA Part 107 certified drone photography and video for real estate agents across South Dakota, plus border areas in Nebraska, Wyoming, and Montana. Two pilots, two hubs — Sioux Falls (SE SD) and Rapid City (West SD, Black Hills).

## Pages
- Home: https://prairieskydrones.com/
- About: https://prairieskydrones.com/about
- Resources/Articles: https://prairieskydrones.com/articles
- Contact/Book: https://prairieskydrones.com/contact

## Services & Pricing
- Residential Flyover: $149
- Luxury / New Construction: $249
- Acreage / Rural Land: $199
- Twilight Shoot (add-on): $99
- Cinematic Video Tour: $349

## Pilots
- Jax Schuster — Sioux Falls hub, SE South Dakota
- Rapid City pilot — West SD, Black Hills, and border areas

## Service Area — Sioux Falls Hub (Jax)
Counties: Minnehaha, Lincoln, Turner, McCook, Moody, Lake, Brookings, Kingsbury, Hamlin, Deuel (SD)
Cities: Sioux Falls, Brandon, Tea, Harrisburg, Dell Rapids, Baltic, Canton, Lennox, Hartford, Brookings, Watertown, Madison, Yankton

## Service Area — Rapid City Hub
SD Counties: Pennington, Meade, Lawrence, Custer, Fall River, Butte, Harding
SD Cities: Rapid City, Sturgis, Spearfish, Deadwood, Hot Springs, Belle Fourche, Custer, Keystone, Hill City
NE Counties: Dawes, Sioux, Sheridan — Cities: Chadron, Crawford, Gordon
WY Counties: Crook, Weston, Campbell — Cities: Sundance, Newcastle, Gillette
MT Counties: Carter, Fallon, Powder River — Cities: Ekalaka, Baker, Broadus
